caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical cup placed inside a shallow, round bowl. Both objects are rendered in shades of brown, orange, and gold, with darker and lighter patches suggesting a mottled, textured surface. The highlights and shadows give a metallic or ceramic appearance. The bowl and the cup appear to be matched in color and material, with the inner part of the bowl visible beneath the cup. The background is plain and unadorned, with a beige or light tan color. There is a small, handwritten inscription in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
